summary: Formats one vehicle-setup parameter value into its display string for a garage/setup menu. The option index a2 selects a 64-byte per-option slot at this + (a2 << 6) + 2992 and dispatches through a large switch (50+ cases) to the correct format specifier, unit conversion (metric vs imperial selected by this+0x4, cm-to-inch 0.3937007874015748, radian-to-degree 57.29577951308232, liter-to-gallon 0.2641720372841846), and optional localized label lookup via BinarySearchInStringTable into byte_5EC4CC. Written output goes to the slot string buffer at +30 (this+3022). Several cases delegate to the sibling helpers SetupValueFormatDS, SetupValueFormat1fS and SetupValueFormatWithOffset. Called only from MenuOptionValueDisplay (0x004673B0).

local_names.this: vehicle setup structure (unit-system flag, labels, gear arrays, fuel factor)
local_names.a2: option index selecting the format path and its 64-byte slot
local_names.v47: temporary stack buffer for the localized lap-count/fuel suffix
local_names.calc: combined slot value = (int at slot+20) * (double at slot+8) + (double at slot+0)

operations.description: Entry: the option index a2 dispatches the format path through a large switch; v4 = (a2 << 6) + this + 2992 addresses the option's 64-byte slot within the setup structure, and the combined value shown by most arms is (int)(slot+20) * (double)(slot+8) + (double)(slot+0).

Case 0 (tire brand/compound): the 'unknown' placeholder string aUnknown is localized via BinarySearchInStringTable into byte_5EC4CC and copied to the slot output buffer (v4+30). The brand is resolved with TireBrandLookup(dword_8AD254, this+112) and the compound with CompoundIndexLookup using the slot index at v4+20; the resolved brand string defaults to byte_5EA438 when empty, is localized into byte_5EC4CC, and written with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck. Returns null when the brand/compound lookup fails.
Cases 1, 2, 0x1F: the combined slot value is formatted as '%4.1f:%4.1f' into the slot output buffer (this + (a2 << 6) + 3022), showing 100.0 - combined*100.0 and combined*100.0.
Case 3: the combined slot value is formatted as '%.2f %s' into v4+30 with the localized 'turns' unit label aTurns (BinarySearchInStringTable into byte_5EC4CC).

Cases 4, 0x34, 0x35, 0x36 (fuel/laps): the counter field this+0x1884 gates whether an 'N/A' label replaces the computed value. a2==52 requires this+0x1884 < 1, a2==53 requires < 2, a2==54 requires >= 3 to fall through to the computed value; otherwise the localized 'N/A' label from off_5C3810 is output as '%s'.

Fuel/laps value computation: when the factor field this+0x1994 is 0.0 the value is unavailable and the buffer holds the localized '(%s)' placeholder; otherwise the combined value is scaled by the factor and truncated with CRTFtol. A result of 1 formats as '(1 %s)' using off_5C3804, any other count as '(%d %s)' using the localized aLaps label; the result is built in the temporary v47 buffer.

Final fuel/laps format: when the unit flag this+0x4 == 1 the value is output as '%4.1f %s %s' with the combined value converted by 0.2641720372841846 (US gallons per liter); otherwise as '%d %s %s' with the integer combined value. Unit label comes from this+88 and the lap-count suffix from the v47 buffer.

Cases 5, 6 (ride height): if the override byte this+0x1989 is set the value is delegated to SetupValueFormatDS; otherwise the combined value is scaled by 100.0 and the unit flag this+0x4 selects '%3.3f'-style '%.3f %s' with cm-to-inch conversion (0.3937007874015748) versus metric '%.2f %s', using label this+24.
Cases 7, 8: the combined value is converted from radians to degrees (multiplied by 57.29577951308232) and formatted as '%.2f %s' with the label at this+40 into the slot output buffer.
Cases 9, 0xA: the combined value scaled by 100.0; the unit flag this+0x4 selects '%.2f %s' with cm-to-inch conversion (0.3937007874015748) versus metric '%.1f %s', using label this+24.
Cases 0xB, 0xC, 0x22: the combined value is converted radians-to-degrees (multiplied by 57.29577951308232) and formatted as '%.1f %s' with the label at this+40.
Cases 0xD, 0xE, 0xF, 0x15: delegates formatting to SetupValueFormatWithOffset(this, slot buffer, 0.0).
Cases 0x10, 0x16: delegates formatting to SetupValueFormatDS(this, slot buffer).
Cases 0x11, 0x12, 0x13, 0x14, 0x17, 0x18, 0x19, 0x1A: delegates formatting to SetupValueFormat1fS(this, slot buffer).
Cases 0x1B, 0x1C: if bit 0 of the flags byte this+0x198C is set, the output is '%d' of (slot int at +20 + 1); otherwise '%d %s' of the combined value with the label at this+40.
Case 0x1D: if bit 1 of this+0x198C is set, the output is '%d' of (slot int at +20 + 1); otherwise '%d%%' of (100.0 - combined value).
Cases 0x1E, 0x26, 0x28: output is '%d' of (slot int at +20 + 1).
Cases 0x20, 0x21, 0x23, 0x24, 0x25: output is '%d%%' of the combined value scaled by 100.0.
Case 0x27: the combined value scaled by 9.549296585513721 is truncated to the integer v44 and output as '%d%03d' of v44 / 1000 and v44 % 1000 (RPM-style display).
Cases 0x29, 0x33: output is '%d' of the slot int at +20.

Case 0x2A (bevel/differential gear): two ratio components are fetched from the array at this+6512 via ArrayElementGetter and BoundedArrayElementAccessor using the slot int at +20, plus the stored gear values this+0x1980 and this+0x1984; the 'bevel' label is localized via BinarySearchInStringTable. If bit 2 of this+0x198C is set the output is '%2d/%2d (%s %2d/%2d)', otherwise the ratio is formatted as '%.2f:1'.

Cases 0x2B, 0x2C, 0x2D, 0x2E, 0x2F, 0x30, 0x31, 0x32 (gear ratios): if the slot byte at +3020 is set, two gear values are fetched via BoundedArrayAccessor and BoundsCheckedArrayLookup and a ratio computed via RatioCalculator over the this+6512 array using this+0x1644 as the track/gear count; bit 2 of this+0x198C selects '%2d/%2d (%.3f)' versus '%.2f (%.2f)'. Otherwise the localized 'N/A' label from off_5C3810 is output as '%s'.
Default arm: returns a2 (the option index) unchanged. All explicit case arms return the output buffer pointer produced by StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (or a delegate helper's result).
